versions.subject: feat: add more rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\CCleanerDU.dll'
filter_main_path:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\CCleaner\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\CCleaner\'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\CCleaner.exe'
        - '\CCleaner64.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\CCleanerDU.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\CCleaner\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\CCleaner\\*") Image IN ("*\\CCleaner.exe", "*\\CCleaner64.exe"))
